functions.name: review_vote_totals
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_vote_totals()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r uuid := coalesce(new.review_id, old.review_id);
begin
  update public.reviews set helpful_count = (select count(*) from public.review_votes v where v.review_id = r) where id = r;
  return null;
end $function$

functions.name: review_report_totals
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_report_totals()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r uuid := coalesce(new.review_id, old.review_id); n integer;
begin
  select count(*) into n from public.review_reports p where p.review_id = r and not p.resolved;
  update public.reviews set report_count = n,
    hidden = hidden or (tg_op = 'INSERT' and n >= 3)
  where id = r;
  return null;
end $function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- Email sign-ups send "name"; Google sends "full_name" / "name" and a photo.
  insert into public.profiles (id, name, avatar_url)
  values (
    new.id,
    left(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', ''), 40),
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'avatar_url', new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'picture')
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: verified
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.verified()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (select bool_or(m ->> 'method' <> 'password')
       from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(auth.jwt() -> 'amr', '[]'::jsonb)) as m),
    false
  );
$function$

functions.name: review_totals
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_totals()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare w text;
begin
  foreach w in array array_remove(array[
    case when tg_op <> 'INSERT' then old.work_id end,
    case when tg_op <> 'DELETE' then new.work_id end
  ], null) loop
    update public.works set
      review_count = (select count(*) from public.reviews r where r.work_id = w and not r.hidden and r.rating is not null),
      review_sum = (select coalesce(sum(rating), 0) from public.reviews r where r.work_id = w and not r.hidden)
    where id = w;
  end loop;
  return null;
end $function$

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Only admins can see the team' using errcode = 'SF020';
  end if;
  return query

end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.kind_class(p_kind text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when p_kind ~* 'film|movie' then 'film' when p_kind ~* 'anim' then 'animation'
    when p_kind ~* 'novel|book' then 'novel' end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_plan(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS plans
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.* from public.subscriptions s join public.plans p on p.id = s.plan_id
  where s.user_id = p_user and s.starts_at <= now() and s.ends_at > now()
  order by p.rank desc limit 1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ticket_message_after()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.staff then
    update public.tickets set status = 'answered', member_unread = true, studio_unread = false, updated_at = now(), closed_at = null
      where id = new.ticket_id;
  else
    update public.tickets set status = 'open', studio_unread = true, updated_at = now(), closed_at = null
      where id = new.ticket_id;
  end if;
  return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_users(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, name text, avatar_url text, created_at timestamp with time zone, last_sign_in_at timestamp with time zone, providers text, role text, locked boolean, orders integer, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  q text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_query, '')));
begin
  if not private.is_owner() then
    raise exception 'Only the owner can see every account' using errcode = 'SF020';
  end if;
  return query
    with hits as (
      select u.id, u.email::text as email, p.name, p.avatar_url, u.created_at, u.last_sign_in_at,
             coalesce((select string_agg(distinct i.provider, ', ') from auth.identities i where i.user_id = u.id), '') as providers,
             a.role, coalesce(u.banned_until > now(), false) as locked,
             (select count(*)::int from public.orders o where o.user_id = u.id) as orders
      from auth.users u
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = u.id
      left join public.admins a on a.user_id = u.id
      where q = '' or lower(u.email) like '%' || q || '%' or lower(coalesce(p.name, '')) like '%' || q || '%' or u.id::text = q
    )
    select h.id, h.email, h.name, h.avatar_url, h.created_at, h.last_sign_in_at, h.providers, h.role, h.locked, h.orders,
           count(*) over () as total
    from hits h
    order by h.created_at desc
    limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1), 200) offset greatest(p_offset, 0);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_licenses()
 RETURNS TABLE(license_id uuid, code text, work_id text, title text, cover_url text, redeemed_at timestamp with time zone, max_devices integer, devices integer, mine boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.verified() then
    raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode = 'SF030';
  end if;
  return query
    select l.id, l.code, l.work_id, w.title, w.cover_url, l.redeemed_at, l.max_devices,
           (select count(*)::int from public.license_devices d where d.license_id = l.id),
           (l.user_id = auth.uid())
    from public.licenses l
    join public.works w on w.id = l.work_id
    where not l.revoked and l.delivered_at is not null
      and (l.user_id = auth.uid() or l.redeemed_by = auth.uid())
    order by l.created_at desc;
end;
$function$

functions.name: release_device
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_device(p_license uuid, p_device_hash text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  hash text := substr(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_device_hash, ''), '[^a-fA-F0-9]', '', 'g'), 1, 128);
begin
  if not private.verified() then
    raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode = 'SF030';
  end if;
  delete from public.license_devices d
    using public.licenses l
   where d.license_id = l.id and d.device_hash = hash and d.license_id = p_license
     and (l.redeemed_by = auth.uid() or (l.user_id = auth.uid() and l.redeemed_by is null));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.order_license_admin(p_order uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(license_id uuid, code text, work_id text, title text, email text, name text, delivered_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then
    raise exception 'Admins only' using errcode = 'SF020';
  end if;
  return query
    select l.id, l.code, l.work_id, w.title, o.email, o.name, l.delivered_at
    from public.licenses l
    join public.orders o on o.id = l.order_id
    join public.works w on w.id = l.work_id
    where l.order_id = p_order and not l.revoked;
end;
$function$
